newsitem.title: SWEDEN: U.S. Losec sales up 40 pct in '96 - Astra.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Losec sales up 40 pct in '96 - Astra.

text.p: Swedish drugs company Astra AB said on Tuesday that total U.S. sales of its blockbuster anti-ulcer agent Losec rose 40 percent in 1996.
Astra said sales of Losec, called Prilosec in the U.S. and marketed through Astra Merck Inc, totalled $1.71 billion compared to $1.23 billion in 1995.

Astra said in statement that Prilosec was approved during the fourth quarter by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for use as initial therapy in the treatment of heartburn and other symptoms related with gastroesophageal reflux disease.
Astra said sales of its drug Plendil through Astra Merck in 1996 rose to $75 million compared to $60 million a year ago.
Astra Merck is owned 50/50 by Astra and U.S. drugs group Merck & Co.
